title: A 1 m quadrat
back: Count each species in each quadrat; boundary plants only if more than half is inside.

title: Population density
back: Divide by all quadrats studied, including those where the species is absent.

title: Population frequency
back: Shows how widely the species is spread.

title: Quadrat procedure
back: Record counts in a table: species × quadrats.

title: Density vs frequency
back: A clumped species can be dense but have low frequency.

title: Quadrat worked example
back: Totals first, then the two formulas.

title: Quadrat precautions
back: Also: identify species carefully and study at least ten quadrats.

title: Throw, don't choose
back: Random quadrats avoid bias towards thick or thin patches.

title: Heads and boxes
back: Density uses plants; frequency uses quadrats where the species occurs.
